tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Shemoneh Esrei: King, Helper, and Deliverer and Shield.

tei:availability.tei:p: Published by Sefaria under CC-BY, which Sefaria defines as Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

tei:div.tei:p: If you forgot to say this, and became aware of your omission before saying the blessing,you should recite it. If you have already said "Blessed are You Adonoy," you must continue the prayers without saying "Remember."King, Helper, and Deliverer and Shield. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Shield of Abraham.

tei:note.tei:p: God is a helper in all the fortunes of life by giving us the necessary energy and talents to succeed. He delivers us from both moral and physical suffering, and He shields us by keeping tragedy and evil influences from us.

These words complete the first blessing of Shemoneh Esrei called “Avos” (Patriarchs). And here too we bend our knees and bow when saying, “Blessed are You.” The major theme of this section is to praise God as “the Great”, as manifested in the Divine protection and providence He gave to the Patriarchs, of whom Abraham was the first.—Vilna Gaon
